cenas.fala: You just found ten million dollars in cash. One problem: you can't spend a single bill.
cenas.descricao: Mint opens a closet stuffed with cash bricks

cenas.fala: In hundreds, that's one hundred thousand notes. About a hundred kilos of paper in your closet.
cenas.descricao: Mint tries to lift a duffel bag of cash, bathroom scale nearby

cenas.fala: So you walk into a bank. Bad idea. Deposit more than ten thousand in cash, and the bank reports it to the government.
cenas.descricao: Mint at a bank counter, teller typing, a form printing in the back

cenas.fala: So you get clever. Nine thousand dollars. Every day. Always just under the line.
cenas.descricao: Mint counting exactly $9,000 at a kitchen table, smug

cenas.fala: Quick math: that's eleven hundred and twelve deposits. More than three years of daily bank visits.
cenas.descricao: Wall calendar covered in X marks, Mint exhausted in a bank line

overlay.sub: 3+ years of bank visits, every single day

cenas.fala: But the bank isn't counting your deposits. It's watching the pattern. Different branches, same day? They add it up.
cenas.descricao: Back office: analyst at monitors full of identical deposit rows

cenas.fala: Always just under ten thousand? That has a name. Structuring.
cenas.descricao: Red alert on a screen, Mint's photo pinned in a case file

cenas.fala: Structuring is a federal crime by itself, even with clean money. Up to five years. Ten, if it tops a hundred grand in a year.
cenas.descricao: Courtroom: judge's gavel mid-air, Mint small at the defense table

overlay.sub: 10 years if over $100k in 12 months · 31 U.S.C. § 5324

cenas.fala: Meanwhile, the bank quietly files a Suspicious Activity Report. By law, they can't tell you. You keep smiling at the teller while the file grows.
cenas.descricao: Split scene: Mint smiling at the teller; behind the wall, a thick folder

overlay.sub: The bank is not allowed to tell you it exists

cenas.fala: A former Speaker of the House got fifteen months in federal prison for this. Not for having the money. For how he moved it.
cenas.descricao: Symbolic: empty marble government hallway, cell bars shadow on the floor

overlay.sub: Pleaded guilty to structuring · sentenced in 2016

cenas.fala: And the cash you already deposited? The government can seize it.
cenas.descricao: Agents carrying evidence boxes out of the bank, Mint watching

cenas.fala: So the bank is a trap. Rewind. The ten million is back in your closet. Do you hide it, or spend it? Comment HIDE or SPEND. The majority writes part two.
cenas.descricao: Mint back at the closet of cash, torn between a shovel and a car key
